newsitem.title: USA: DataTrend plans $1 mln in annual savings.
newsitem.headline: DataTrend plans $1 mln in annual savings.

text.p: DataTrend Services Inc said Monday its decision to relocate its Braintree, Mass., warehouse and refurbishment operation to Memphis, Tenn., is part of a plan to cut costs $1,000,000 per year.
The move is expected to take place by June 30, the company said.
DataTrend also said it has eliminated the position of chief operating officer held by Ira Cohen, as well as other redundant layers of management.

Each of the 43 Braintree employees has been notified of the closure, the company said. It said it will retain about 25 to continue to operate a Boston facility to handle administration, sales and project management.
The company said the Memphis area offers a more readily available labor pool at lower costs, less costly real estate and utilities.
After the reductions, DataTrend said it will employ about 95 people, representing a 25 percent reduction since year-end 1996.
